description: Defines a PagePreview control for rendering PDF page previews within a Windows Forms application, including zoom, scrollbars, and rendering logic.

classes.name: PagePreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms UserControl for previewing PDF pages with zoom and scroll support, rendering via delegate.

methods.name: PagePreview
methods.description: Constructor initializing the preview control, setting up scrollbars and default properties.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the control.

methods.name: SetRenderFunction
methods.description: Assigns a delegate to render the page content.

methods.name: CalculatePreviewDimension
methods.description: Calculates zoom and page size in pixels based on control size and zoom mode.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders the page content onto a Graphics object, applying transformations and delegate rendering.

methods.name: PaintBackground
methods.description: Paints the background and page border.

methods.name: SetScrollBarRange
methods.description: Adjusts scrollbar ranges based on virtual canvas size.
